DESCRIPTION SPECIFICATIONS KF556C40BB2-32 32GB 4G x 64-Bit DDR5-5600 CL40 288-Pin DIMM Continued >> FEATURES Kingston FURY KF556C40BB2-32 is a 4G x 64-bit (32GB) DDR5-5600 CL40 SDRAM (Synchronous DRAM) 1Rx8, memory module, based on eight 4G x 8-bit FBGA components per module. The module supports AMD® EXPO v1.1 and Intel® Extreme Memory Profiles (Intel® XMP) 3.0. Each module has been tested to run at DDR5-5600 at a low latency timing of 40-40-40 at 1.25V. The SPDs are programmed to JEDEC standard latency DDR5-4800 timing of 40-39-39 at 1.1V. Each 288-pin DIMM uses gold contact fingers. The JEDEC standard electrical and mechanical specifications are as follows: CL(IDD) Row Cycle Time (tRCmin) Refresh to Active/Refresh Command Time (tRFCmin) Row Active Time (tRASmin) UL Rating Operating Temperature Storage Temperature 40 cycles 48ns(min.) 410ns(min.) 32ns(min.) 94 V - 0 0 o C to +85 o C -55 o C to +100 o C FACTORY TIMING PARAMETERS • Default (JEDEC): DDR5-4800 CL40-39-39 @1.1V • EXPO Profile #0: DDR5-5600 CL40-40-40 @1.25V • EXPO Profile #1: DDR5-5200 CL40-40-40 @1.25V • XMP Profile #1: DDR5-5600 CL40-40-40 @1.25V • XMP Profile #2: DDR5-5200 CL40-40-40 @1.25V • Power Supply: VDD = 1.1V Typical • VDDQ = 1.1V Typical • VPP = 1.8V Typical • VDDSPD = 1.8V to 2.0V • On-Die ECC • Height 1.37” (34.9mm), w/heatsink Memory Module Specifications kingston.com Rev.
